title: BPO Abstract Operations Catalogue
description: Machine-readable catalogue of the abstract operations (kinds of state change) that BPO properties quantify over. Operations are deliberately abstract — function signatures appear only under each operation's `examples` field and are explicitly non-normative. This JSON Schema fixes the file SHAPE; internal integrity (id uniqueness, governs_properties closure into the BPO corpus, iso20022_intents closure into mappings/iso20022.framework.json) is enforced by schema/validate_refs.py.

inclusion_bar.description: The written test a candidate must pass to be admitted to operations[]. Enforced by review, not by code.

definition.description: One-line paraphrased definition in our own words.

state_change.description: The formal effect on state, in the corpus's signature vocabulary.

examples.description: Illustrative function signatures across platforms. NON-NORMATIVE — the ontology does not commit to maintaining function-level coverage.

iso20022_intents.description: ISO 20022 message ids (and optionally components/elements) whose business intent this operation realizes. Closure-checked against mappings/iso20022.framework.json by schema/validate_refs.py.

governs_properties.description: BPO properties whose formalization governs this operation. Plain string for clean cases, {property, note} object when authorial judgment is in play (e.g. partial coverage). Closure-checked against the property corpus by schema/validate_refs.py.

candidates_pending_grounding.description: Candidates considered but held out of the catalogue because no current BPO property quantifies over them as a distinct kind of state change. Tracked explicitly so they are not silently re-proposed; admitted to operations[] only when at least one property's formalization governs them.
